top_signals.title: U.S. Diesel Exports Hit Record High as Domestic Stockpiles Slide
top_signals.summary: Diesel fuel exports from the United States hit an all-time high last week, driven by shortages of the fuel in other parts of the world as a result of the energy crisis in the Middle East. According to the Energy Information Administration, the United States exported diesel fuel at a rate of 1.9 million barrels daily last week, breaking the previous record, set in spring. However, the EIA data also showed that diesel fuel production fell last week—as did inventories of the fuel. They now sit 12% lower than the five-year average. Most of the…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: East African Breweries Profit Grows Fastest in Four Years
top_signals.summary: East African Breweries Plc’s annual profit grew at the fastest pace in four years, even as accelerating inflation in its home market Kenya eroded spending power.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Commerzbank CEO on Results, UniCredit, Buybacks
top_signals.summary: "We have seen a record net income for the first half of the year," Commerzbank Chief Executive Officer Bettina Orlopp says, adding that results show the bank is able to deliver "despite all turbulences there might be out there." She also comments on the relationship with UniCredit, buybacks and shareholder value. (Source: Bloomberg)
